title: Show the unit-weight GL2 machine reverses every column at one gap
body:
## Summary
- The depth-zero unit ROOT at q=3 returns weight 1 on all 64 body coordinates. The published GL2(F3) machine compiles the different pair (2, 1).
- Installing (1, 1) in that machine, at one gap, makes all 15552 columns match the position reversal. The published pair disagrees on 72 of the 81 columns in one row.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The fixture still takes the weight pair from its source text; it does not parse the ROOT tape.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/selected-unit-weight-reversal/verify.py` (about 277 seconds)
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/selected-unit-weight-reversal/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-unit-weight-reversal`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
